visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a cream-colored cardigan with grey cat illustrations, stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a white sweatshirt against her chest and laughs heartily with an open mouth and squinted eyes. Behind her, white walls feature black-and-white stylized line art of cartoonish shapes. A large red circular graphic with a white character '秘' covers her hands. (2) The scene shifts to the woman sitting on a light-colored wooden floor. A toddler in a blue denim overall sits beside her. A large yellow and white shipping parcel is placed in front of her. She gestures with her hands, pointing her index finger upward and then making an 'OK' sign while talking to someone off-camera. The lighting is warm and bright indoor light. (3) She opens the plastic shipping bag and pulls out a white sweatshirt. The garment features a large, plush, 3D character face representing a boy with dark hair. She smiles widely and holds the shirt up for the camera to see the detail. The background shows a modern living space with minimalist decor. (4) The woman demonstrates the sweatshirt's unique feature by sliding a purple-and-white tissue pack into a hidden opening behind the character's plush nose. She then pulls a white tissue out through the character's nostril area, mimicking mucus. She breaks into intense, high-energy laughter, doubling over slightly while holding the garment. (5) She stands up and holds the sweatshirt out at arm's length, displaying the tissue hanging from the character's nose. A young boy wearing a blue cap and a green patterned shirt is visible sitting on the floor nearby. A male hand holding a black remote control enters the frame from the bottom right to interact with the scene. The woman continues to laugh and talk animatedly.
